title: Debt and Cipher
author: Odile Voss
blurb: Felix Reyes, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
